about:
The Cable Company operates from Tempe, Arizona. The company's website carries a 2008 copyright notice, indicating it has been in business since at least that year. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company supplies low voltage cable for data, voice, video, security, sound, fire, building automation, and home automation applications. It also provides fiber optic products, structured wiring components, and cable assemblies. Beyond stocked products, the company constructs custom audio, video, voice, and computer cables and offers design assistance for specialized cable needs.

The Cable Company serves customers in telecommunications, security systems, audio/video installation, fire safety, building automation, and home automation markets. Its products are used in structured wiring projects, network infrastructure, and custom cable assemblies for commercial and residential installations.

The company states that it is structured to deliver quality and service at competitive prices, and that its focus on low voltage cable systems enables it to better serve customer interests in the marketplace.
